summary: Preserve a hash-safe conflict signal for multiple distinct Message-ID values in one email and mark the resulting workflow group ambiguous.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where two distinct Message-ID headers were discarded and the email was mislabeled SINGLE
Existing privacy requirement that raw email thread identifiers are not persisted
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued Email accuracy and adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: The deterministic check distinguishes multiple distinct hashed Message-ID values; it does not infer which malformed identity was intended.
An email without Message-ID remains a standalone item and semantic thread reconstruction remains unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
